native_dependencies_post_publication_aud.conclusion: Desktop scientific closure has undeclared external dependencies: libtbb.so.12 and libgomp.so.1.0.0 are not bundled in the exact public AppImage and libtbb12/libgomp1 are absent from public DEB Depends. Numba catches backend ImportError and defaults to another threading backend, so this does not itself prove Studio startup failure. Explicit tbb/omp or safe/threadsafe selection can fail without the corresponding system library.
